description: This source file defines the ArticlesController class within an ASP.NET Core application. The controller manages RESTful endpoints related to articles, such as listing, retrieving details, creating, editing, and deleting articles. It uses MediatR for handling requests and supports authorization with JWT schemes.

classes.name: ArticlesController
classes.description: Controller class responsible for handling article-related HTTP requests, using dependency injection for IMediator, and defining endpoints for CRUD operations and listings.

methods.name: Get
methods.description: Handles GET requests to retrieve a list of articles, with optional query parameters such as tag, author, favorited, limit, and offset.

methods.name: GetFeed
methods.description: Handles GET requests to retrieve the personal feed of articles, similar to the Get method but filtering for the user's feed.

methods.name: Get
methods.description: Handles GET requests to retrieve the details of a specific article identified by the slug.

methods.name: Create
methods.description: Handles POST requests to create a new article, requires authorization.

methods.name: Edit
methods.description: Handles PUT requests to update an existing article identified by the slug, requires authorization.

methods.name: Delete
methods.description: Handles DELETE requests to remove an article identified by the slug, requires authorization.
